cards.title: Shuffle, then Reshuffle
cards.body: Shuffle now mixes the queue once, so the list shows what plays next. Reshuffle in the queue mixes the rest again without stopping the song.

cards.title: Add to queue plays next
cards.body: Songs you add play right after this one, in the order you added them. Play next is gone; this does its job.

cards.title: Faster back to your music
cards.body: When you open Riff, the song you left paused is ready, so Play starts almost at once.
